_what: PREPARED — NOT APPLIED. One anam_tool_update (PUT https://api.anam.ai/v1/tools/{id}) sending `body` exactly ({id, ...body}); `config` REPLACES the whole stored config; expectedUpdatedAt = the tool's updatedAt read on 2026-11-20 → a 409 means someone changed it since: read it again (anam_tool_get) and re-check before retrying. `rollback_body` puts back the definition read on 2026-11-20.
read_at: 2026-11-20 (anam_tool_get 325b182c-e5e0-42d0-a130-658919faf12f, read-only, by the design step; not re-read by the build step)
order: After deploy-site (data/janna-live.js reads a.ids) and deploy-worker (POST /api/advisor/notify accepts items) — before that the page ignores ids. awaitResult stays false, so no page handler is needed and old tabs / the widget are not left waiting.

tools.name: bassem_notify_member
tools.why: Owner 2026-11-19: the «ابعتلي» e-mail had no data, no attachment and no working link. With ids the platform adds each opportunity's details, links and official file itself; Bassem never promises any of it (review R3). Without ids the page picks the opportunities from the call's own tool results and screen (data/janna-live.js notifyRefs).

body.description: Send the member HIMSELF a short note on his registered WhatsApp and/or e-mail («ابعتلي», «على إيميلي»): what you did together, an opportunity, a reply, a deadline. When the note is about opportunities your tools returned in THIS call, put the id of each one in `ids` exactly as returned (a bassem_intel id like rw0000000a1, or the platform tender id from janna_lookup / platform_item), at most 3; an opportunity from an earlier call: fetch it again with its tool by the id in your memory first. The platform then adds what it can from its own data: details, links and, when the source allows a download, the official file. Never write links, amounts or dates in `message` that are not in the results. Tell him you are sending it; do not promise details, links or files — the e-mail itself says what it carries, and you hear the outcome afterwards.

message.description: The summary/alert text in the member's language

ids.description: Ids of the opportunities this note is about, exactly as this call's tools returned them, comma-separated (an id may contain spaces), at most 3 (e.g. rw0000000a1,eg-tnd-003). Empty for a general note.

rollback_body.description: Send the member a short summary or alert on their registered WhatsApp and/or email (e.g. what you did together today, a new opportunity, a reply received, a deadline). Tell the member you are sending it.

message.description: The summary/alert text in the member's language

not_changed: type CLIENT, awaitResult false (an awaited tool would leave Bassem silent in old tabs and the widget until it times out — anam/APPLY.md), the persona's toolIds (worker/test/bassem-meetings.test.mjs keeps notify out of meetings), every other tool.
